card.name: Accented letters in Spanish and Portuguese words
card.fires_on: Pieces of Spanish or Portuguese words and names that contain an accented letter such as á, ó or í. It fires on the accented piece itself or the piece just after it.

modes.label: Names with accents
modes.description: Pieces of Iberian or Latin American personal names, often starting with Á or containing ó.
modes.example: Manuel Á<<lv>>ares de Barros and Lianor

modes.label: Spanish or Portuguese common words
modes.description: Parts of ordinary words in Spanish, Portuguese or plant names, split around an accented vowel.

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of Spanish and Portuguese words and names that have accent marks.
